import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import traces from "./fixtures/v0.1-replays.json" with { type: "json" };
import { initialState } from "../src/game/state/initialState.js";
import { reducer } from "../src/game/state/reducer.js";
// Frozen traces generated by 0.1.0. Intentionally changing the rules requires a
// new ruleset/save policy, not blindly regenerating these fixtures.
for (const trace of traces)
  test(`compatibilidade 0.1.0: decisões e saves da seed ${trace.seed}`, () => {
    let state = initialState();
    for (const [index, step] of trace.steps.entries()) {
      state = reducer(state, step.action);
      const hash = createHash("sha256")
        .update(JSON.stringify(state))
        .digest("hex");
      assert.equal(hash, step.hash, `decisão ${index}: ${step.action.type}`);
    }
  });
